title: Message Action Browser Fixture
principle: Critical transcript actions must be proven against browser-local state, not only static selectors.
public_repo_rule: Fixture evidence is synthetic and public-safe. It contains no real prompts, real responses, provider keys, tokens, pairing codes, billing data or private telemetry.

scenarios.expected: Writes one browser-local conversation, keeps active conversation id and opens the conversation manager.
Creates a new local fork ending at the selected answer and replaces only local runtime messages.
Stores and copies a redacted share draft while opening Safe Sharing.
Opens model picker before a usable live model and conversation manager after a usable live model.
